name: paddock
description: Spatially explicit pastoral farm simulator for New Zealand conditions

config.description: TOML configuration parsing and logging outside core

gis.description: Geospatial input/output: DEM, cadastre, waterways (M3). libtiff carries the LERC codec because that is what LINZ compresses its 1 m elevation with; without it GDAL reports 'LERC compression support is not configured' and the tile will not open at all. The codec belongs to tiff rather than to gdal - gdal's own lerc feature is for its standalone LERC and MRF drivers, and does not reach TIFF compression.

gui.description: Qt6 desktop application and VTK 2D/3D visualisation (M2-M3)

ai.description: Optional LLM features; excluded from the default CI build (M6)
